preconditions.description: The number of students n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= fi <= n and fi != i and 1 <= si <= 2 for i, (fi, si) in enumerate(students, 1))
preconditions.description: Each student's best friend fi is a valid student number (not themselves), and their sex si is either 1 (boy) or 2 (girl).

postconditions.description: The number of formed pairs t is equal to the length of the pairs list.

postconditions.expression: e == sum(1 for a, b in pairs if students[a-1][1] != students[b-1][1])
postconditions.description: The number of boy-girl pairs e is the count of pairs where the students have different sexes.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in pairs)
postconditions.description: Each pair consists of two distinct valid student numbers.

postconditions.expression: len(set(a for a, b in pairs).union(set(b for a, b in pairs))) == 2 * t
postconditions.description: Each student appears in at most one pair.

postconditions.expression: all((a, b) in pairs or (b, a) in pairs for i, (fi, si) in enumerate(students, 1) if i in {a for a, b in pairs} or i in {b for a, b in pairs})
postconditions.description: Each student in a pair is the best friend of the other student in the pair.
